title: Tensor cancellation for sheaf scalar extension in independent coefficient universes
statement: Let R→S be arbitrary commutative ring sheaves on a site small in a coefficient universe [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For an S-module M and R-module N there is an R-module isomorphism U(M tensor_S (S tensor_R N))≅UM tensor_R N. It is natural simultaneously in M,N, and uses the actual sheafified scalar extension and sheaf tensor, without a flatness assumption.

proof.text: Restriction commutes with sheafification on underlying abelian presheaves. The scalar-extension presheaf unit becomes invertible after tensoring and sheafifying, by the monoidal localization property. Compose these comparisons with the balanced equivalence. Naturality of sheafification, its counit and the tensor comparison proves simultaneous naturality.
